verses.gurmukhi: ਦਸ ਅਵਤਾਰੀ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਵੈਰ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਜੋਧ ਲੜਵਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhas avataaree bisan hoi vair virodh jodh laRavaae|

en.bdb: In his ten incarnations Visnu caused the opposing warriors fight each other.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ ਕਰਿ ਦੁਇ ਧੜੇ ਦੈਤ ਹਰਾਏ ਦੇਵ ਜਿਤਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dhev dhaanav kar dhui dhaRe dhait haraae dhev jitaae|

en.bdb: He created two factions of gods and demons and out of them he helped the gods win and caused the defeat of demons.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਛ ਕਛ ਵੈਰਾਹ ਰੂਪ ਨਰਸਿੰਘ ਬਾਵਨ ਬੋਧ ਉਪਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: machh kachh vairaeh roop narasi(n)gh baavan bodh upaae|

en.bdb: He created incarnations in the forms of Fish, Tortoise, Varah (Boar), Narsingh (Man-lion), Vaman (Dwarf) and the Buddh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਿਲਕ ਕਲੰਕੀ ਨਾਉ ਗਣਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: parasaraam raam kirasan hoi kilak kala(n)kee naau ganaae|

en.bdb: The names of Pars'u Ram, Ram, Krsna, Kalki are also counted among his incarnations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਚਲ ਚਲਿਤ ਪਖੰਡ ਬਹੁ ਵਲ ਛਲਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਵਧਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)chal chalit pakha(n)dd bahu val chhalakar parapa(n)ch vadhaae|

en.bdb: Through their deceptive and frolicsome characters, they increased delusions, deceits and convolutions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਨ ਦਿਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham nirabhau nira(n)kaar na dhikhaae|

en.bdb: Nothing was done to have the glimpse of fearless, formless, transcendent, perfect Brahm. Ksatriyas were annihilated

verses.gurmukhi: ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਮਾਰਿ ਸੰਘਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਮਾਯਣ ਮਹਾਭਾਰਤ ਭਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: khatree maar sa(n)ghaar kar raamaayan mahaabhaarat bhaae|

en.bdb: And the Ramayan and the Mahabharat epics were composed to please the people.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧੁ ਨ ਮਾਰਿਓ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: kaam karodh na maario lobh moh aha(n)kaar na jaae|

en.bdb: Lust and anger were not deci­mated, nor greed,infatuation and ego were wiped out.
Without the holy congregation, the human birth was lost in vain.
